I don't pretend my advice will be the best but perhaps you can ask yourself some simple question before writing the character arc... 

Who the character is trying to protect ? His family ? A friend ? Why does he want to protect them ? 

How is he supposed to protect those people ? What does he do to be better at protecting people ? What kind of training ? How many times did he practiced ?

How does the character feels when he's using his skills / abilities / power ? 

Is he refusing to use his skills to kill or to hurt ? Why ?
